enrichment.headline: Allows temporary borrowing of up to $30M from the Alameda County Treasury in 2019-20
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution asking the Alameda County Treasury for a temporary transfer of funds of no more than $30 million. The text says this is because district revenue and receipts fluctuate during fiscal year 2019-2020. The text does not say how or when the funds would be repaid.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Temporary Transfer of Funds - Up To $30 Million - Fiscal Year 2019-2020 - County of Alameda Treasury - Chief Financial Officer

enrichment.headline: Sets up temporary transfers between district funds for fiscal year 2019-20
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution to establish temporary interfund transfers, meaning short-term moves of money between district funds, for fiscal year 2019-2020. The text gives no dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Temporary Interfund Transfers - Fiscal Year 2019-2020 - Chief Financial Officer

enrichment.headline: Pays FM3 Research up to $33,000 to survey voters on a possible 2020 school facilities bond
enrichment.summary: FM3 Research of Oakland will conduct a public opinion survey of district voters on a potential 2020 General Obligation Bond to modernize district facilities. The agreement runs from August 29, 2019 through June 30, 2020, and the cost cannot exceed $33,000.

vendor.name: FM3 Research (Fairbank, Maslin, Maullin, Metz and Associates)

items.fundingSource: Fund 40 - Special Reserve for Capital Outlay Projects
items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: General Services Agreement - FM3 Research - Facilities Planning & Management Department

enrichment.headline: Sets rent for the district's 1000 Broadway offices at about $236K to $251K a month through 2022
enrichment.summary: This fourth amendment to the office lease with Sparknight, LLC sets monthly base rent for the central administrative offices at 1000 Broadway. Rent is $236,304.80 a month from September 2019, $243,393.94 from September 2020 and $250,695.76 from September 2021, through August 31, 2022. The district also pays its share of increases in taxes and operating expenses starting January 1, 2020. The text does not state a total.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Fourth Amendment, Office Lease - Sparknight, LLC - Central Administrative Offices - 1000 Broadway, Oakland, CA

enrichment.headline: Adds $5,000 for Siegfried Engineering's extra Westlake Middle School field design work
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds design services for an additional basketball court retrofit, a drinking fountain, court striping and painting of seat walls at the Westlake Middle School Field Project. It adds $5,000 and raises the agreement's cap from $85,902.68 to $90,902.68.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 3, Agreement for Architectural Services - Siegfried Engineering, Inc. - Westlake Middle School Field Project

enrichment.headline: Approves a new or revised job description for Truck Driver
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution creating or revising the district's job description for the Truck Driver position. The text gives no dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Creation/Revision of Job Description - Truck Driver - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Adopts Personnel Report No. 1920-0002 from the Talent/Human Resources Department
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts the district's Personnel Report No. 1920-0002. The agenda text does not list the individual personnel actions or any dollar amounts.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Personnel Report No. 1920-0002 - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Partners with Academy of Art University for art-teacher student teaching, at no cost, to 2022
enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Academy of Art University's School of Education in San Francisco sets up a practica program, meaning supervised classroom placements, for K-12 teaching in single subject and designated subject art education. It runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022 and costs the district nothing.

vendor.name: Academy of Art University, School of Education

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding and Interagency Agreement - District and Academy of Art University, School of Art Education -Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Partners with Saint Mary's College on teacher and counselor training programs at no cost to 2022
enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Saint Mary's College of California in Moraga covers an intern partnership program, student teaching placements, and internships for school counselors, clinical educational therapists, clinical school psychologists and administrators. It also covers practica and immersive experiences for undergraduates working toward a credential. It runs July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022 at no cost to the district.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding and Agreement - District and Saint Mary's College of California - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Partners with Trellis Education on a two-year STEM teacher pathway funded by a state residency grant
enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Trellis Education covers the STEM Teacher Pathway and Mentor Fellow Project for July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2021. The district would pass through money from a California teacher credentialing residency grant, with fiscal oversight under the grant award agreement. The text does not state a dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding - District STEM Teacher Pathway and Mentor Fellow Project 2019-2021 - District and Trellis Education - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Renews UC Berkeley teacher-training partnership for 2019-20 at no district cost
enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the Regents of the University of California, through UC Berkeley's Graduate School of Education, covers intern partnership and practica programs, meaning supervised placements, for K-12 teaching and other school credentials. It runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, with no district funding and no fiscal oversight.

vendor.name: Regents of the University of California, UC Berkeley Graduate School of Education

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding - University of California, Berkeley, Graduate School of Education - Intern Partnership and Practica Programs for K-12 Teaching - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Creates job descriptions for Position Control Analyst and Senior Executive Director, Accounting
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution creating district job descriptions for two positions: Analyst, Position Control and Senior Executive Director, Accounting. The text gives no dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Creating Job Descriptions - Analyst, Position Control and Senior Executive Director, Accounting - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts $85,000 from Oakland's Fund for Children and Youth for Oakland International High School
enrichment.summary: The district accepts $85,000 from the City of Oakland's KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth. The money supports on-campus wellness services, targeted help for high-risk youth, leadership training and restorative justice for more than 357 newly arrived immigrant high school students a year at Oakland International High School. The grant covers July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020.

vendor.name: City of Oakland - KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth

items.fundingSource: City of Oakland - KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Agreement - City of Oakland - KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth - Oakland International High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Peralta Community College District up to $419,584 to run Gateway to College at Laney in 2019-20
enrichment.summary: Peralta Community College District will operate Gateway to College at Laney Alternative High School, the district's alternative high school on the Laney College campus. The agreement runs July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The limit of $419,583.72 is described as an attendance-based (ADA) amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement - Gateway to College - Laney Alternative High School - School Year 2019-2020 - High School Network

enrichment.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $199,864 to run Madison Park Upper Campus after-school program
enrichment.summary: Under this memorandum of understanding (MOU), Bay Area Community Resources serves as lead agency for the after-school program at Madison Park Academy Upper Campus. It provides program coordination, math intervention, homework support, student supervision and enrichment. The term is August 1, 2019 through July 31, 2020, and the cost cannot exceed $199,864.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant; 21st Century Community Learning Centers Grant; After School Education and Safety (ASES) Kids Code Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding - Bay Area Community Resources - After School Program - Madison Park Academy Upper Campus

enrichment.summary: The Board adopts its calendar of agenda items for meetings from August 2019 through June 2020. It also lets the Board President make further adjustments to the calendar unless the Board decides otherwise.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointment of a new member to the 7-11 Committee, starting August 29, 2019. The member succeeds a previous member and serves the unexpired term, which ends April 14, 2021.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
